audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give six of seven stages to Vayne and Level 6 to 'Skill', yet the entry's own prose says Level 6 'converts the lane from pure survival into active threat' and Sejuani wins the matchup 52.2% over 182 games.
audit.why: A chart that never once gives Sejuani a stage contradicts a winning record and contradicts the text sitting next to it. The packet's levelChart reads Vayne / Vayne / Skill / Skill / Sejuani / Skill / Vayne. Level 6 is where Glacial Prison's 1300-unit stun outranges everything Vayne can answer, and it should read Sejuani rather than Skill.
audit.corrected: Level 6 belongs to Sejuani: Glacial Prison is a 1300-unit projectile stun that also reveals stealth, and Vayne has no way to refuse it at that range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spikes cover Level 6 and first item but never give Vayne's ultimate a number, and never say that Final Hour is what actually changes her Level 6.
audit.why: Final Hour is 100/85/70 seconds and it is the reason her 6 is dangerous: bonus AD, roughly halved Tumble cooldown, and invisibility on every Tumble. Without the number the player cannot tell a Final Hour window from a normal one, and a Sejuani who walks into a Final Hour skirmish with her own R down dies for it.
audit.corrected: Final Hour: 100/85/70s. During it Tumble (6/5/4/3/2s base) returns roughly twice as fast and turns her invisible on each cast.
sources: champ-data/_kits/vayne.json (Final Hour cooldown 100/85/70, 'Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown'; Tumble 6/5/4/3/2)

audit.whatIsWrong: Glacial Prison reveals stealth. Vayne's only stealth is Final Hour's Tumble invisibility. Neither layer mentions this anywhere; the Level 6 spike instead sells R as a way to 'catch a Tumble-forward'.
audit.why: This is the decisive interaction of the matchup and it answers Vayne's strongest defensive trick. From 6 onward the standard Vayne pattern in a side-lane skirmish is Final Hour and then Tumble out of vision to reset the fight. A 1300-range projectile that stuns and reveals refuses that pattern outright, and it is the one thing Sejuani owns that Vayne cannot space away from.
audit.corrected: Glacial Prison reveals stealth over 1300 units and stuns the first champion hit — it strips Final Hour's invisible Tumbles. It answers her escape, not just her engage.
sources: champ-data/_kits/sejuani.json (Glacial Prison: revealsStealth, projectile, range 1300, 'stuns the first champion hit')

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer credits Sejuani's resistances to 'your passive Permafrost resistances' in four places. Permafrost is her E stun; the resistances are Frost Armor from Fury of the North. Separately the text treats Silver Bolts as an auto-attack counter only.
audit.why: Naming the wrong ability as the source of the resistances teaches the player the wrong mechanic to protect — Frost Armor is conditional on being out of combat, and attaching it to E erases that condition. And Silver Bolts triggers on the third consecutive attack OR ability on the same target, so a Vayne who mixes Condemn into two autos gets the true-damage proc a beat earlier than the text implies. That beat is the difference between surviving a wall-stun and not.
audit.corrected: Silver Bolts procs on the third consecutive attack or ability against the same target, and its true damage ignores Frost Armor's armour and MR entirely.
sources: champ-data/_kits/vayne.json (Silver Bolts: 'third consecutive attack or ability against the same target ... bonus true damage')
champ-data/_kits/sejuani.json (Fury of the North grants Frost Armor; Permafrost is the E stun)

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn is named as the matchup-defining cooldown in breakdown.cooldowns, the loading line, focus and three do/don't entries, but its duration appears nowhere in either layer.
audit.why: The entire plan is 'step up on Condemn's downtime'. Without the number that instruction is unplayable. Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s and Tumble is 6/5/4/3/2s; those two numbers are the whole trade schedule of this lane.
audit.corrected: Condemn: 20/18/16/14/12s. Tumble: 6/5/4/3/2s, and shorter again under Final Hour.
